about_the_game:
MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator set in a dystopian future where you play as space miners working for a ruthless megacorporation, far from Earth. Completing your job might just be harder than staying alive - and that’s saying something.

As part of a mining crew, your mission is to complete a quota made up of various objectives. But danger lurks in every task: random threats, hostile environments, and even betrayal from within the team. Sometimes the greatest threat isn’t aliens - it’s your clumsy, chaotic crewmates.

Restore the base, split up responsibilities, scan and analyze deposits, and follow strict corporate protocols to extract resources. Process and deliver materials while facing mounting threats - from aggressive alien lifeforms to a hidden traitor with a personal agenda: sabotage, disruption, or even assassination.

Whether it’s poor planning, accidents, or sabotage, survival is never guaranteed. Cooperation is your best chance... but trust is optional.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-11400 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator of miners in space, in an alternative dystopian future. You take on the role of space miners working for an evil corporation far from home, and it will be much easier for you to die than to do your job.
